metadata.title: DELIVERSO

meta.title: DELIVERSO | A delicious universe of flavors
meta.description: Creative pastry where flavor, design, and imagination become unique experiences for every occasion.

hero.title: DELIVERSO
hero.description: More than desserts — experiences in every bite.

intro.heading: More than desserts, experiences made to be remembered.
intro.body: At DELIVERSO we combine craft, creativity, and design to turn each product into an experience of its own. From a special celebration to a fully personal idea, every creation begins with a concept and ends in flavor.

featured.heading: Featured
featured.intro: A look at pieces that combine gastronomic craft with a contemporary aesthetic.

chocolate-cake.name: Chocolate cake
chocolate-cake.description: A contemporary reading of cacao, with a clean finish for the table.

fruit-creation.name: Fruit creation
fruit-creation.description: Bright layers and a luminous profile, suited to daytime occasions.

special-edition.name: Special edition
special-edition.description: A piece for the occasion, ready to become a universe of its own.

universes.heading: Every occasion has its own universe.
universes.body: Color, flavor, theme, and design can come together around an idea that is yours.

celebrations.title: Celebrations
celebrations.description: Birthdays, gathering tables, and moments that deserve a centerpiece.

fantasy.title: Fantasy
fantasy.description: Form, color, and atmosphere for imaginative ideas, unbound to any franchise.

elegance.title: Elegance
elegance.description: Quiet compositions, a contained palette, and a fine-pastry finish.

custom.title: Your own universe
custom.description: An open starting point: you bring the idea; DELIVERSO shapes it.

personalization.heading: You imagine it. DELIVERSO creates it.
personalization.body: Personalization joins an idea to a pastry creation. Choose a concept, shape the character of the piece, and receive an experience made for that occasion.

idea.title: Choose an idea
idea.description: An occasion, a color, a concept, or an aesthetic reference of your own.

craft.title: Shape your creation
craft.description: Flavor, form, and presentation align around that idea.

receive.title: Receive your order
receive.description: The piece arrives as a complete experience, not a generic dessert.

creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.description: Every proposal can follow an idea of your own.

design.title: Design

flavor.title: Flavor
flavor.description: Visual identity never replaces gastronomic quality.

meta.title: Design System — DELIVERSO
meta.description: Internal review of identity, tokens, and foundational components.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.intro: Foundational visual language for DELIVERSO. This page is not commercial; it exists to review primitives.
designSystem.cosmosNote: Cosmos as accent. Pastry as protagonist.

color.heading: Palette
color.goldWarning: Gold is not used as small text on Cream: it fails AA contrast.

typography.heading: Typography
typography.sampleBodyLg: Each creation is designed to turn an idea into an experience, with gastronomic craft and a contemporary aesthetic.
typography.sampleBody: Body copy uses Manrope to keep navigation, descriptions, prices, and forms clear.
typography.sampleBodySm: Supporting text for cards, help copy, and quiet metadata.

forms.heading: Forms
forms.nameHelper: The label stays visible; the placeholder supports it, it does not replace it.
forms.dedicationPlaceholder: A short note for the order
forms.invalidError: Please review this field to continue.

cards.heading: Cards
cards.title: Visual primitive
cards.description: An elevated surface for grouping content without business logic.
cards.body: A soft border, quiet shadow, and contained radius. Elevation should never compete with photography.

product.heading: Product card
product.name: Cacao and vanilla tart
product.description: Cacao layers, vanilla cream, and a clean finish for the table.

featured.heading: Featured
featured.title: Pieces for a precise table
featured.description: A visual pattern for highlighting creations later chosen from admin, without crowding the photograph.

dark.heading: Dark surface
dark.body: Navy and Purple for promotional blocks, footer, and special experiences. This is not a global theme switcher.

motion.heading: Motion
motion.body: Short transitions and standard easing. Quiet hover; no zoom, glow, or bounce. prefers-reduced-motion is respected.

icons.heading: Iconography
icons.body: Functional Lucide icons. Emojis are not used as interface iconography.
